01

Purpose

This Service Level Agreement defines the service commitments, monitoring standards, threat detection capabilities, incident response, platform availability, support response times and customer responsibilities for the Acronis Advanced XDR (Extended Detection & Response) service provided by XcellHost Cloud Services Pvt. Ltd.

Acronis Advanced XDR delivers unified threat detection and response by correlating telemetry across endpoints, email, identities, cloud workloads, servers and networks. The service provides centralized visibility, automated investigation, threat intelligence and rapid incident response to help organizations detect, contain and respond to sophisticated cyber threats.

23. Disclaimer

This SLA applies to Acronis Advanced XDR (Extended Detection & Response) services delivered by XcellHost Cloud Services Pvt. Ltd. While the service provides advanced threat detection, cross-domain correlation, automated investigation and expert security monitoring, no cybersecurity solution can guarantee prevention of every cyberattack or security incident.

Service effectiveness depends on proper deployment, supported environments, continuous connectivity, customer cooperation and timely implementation of recommended remediation actions.
